About.title: About Us
About.body: From strategy and design to development and launch — we deliver end-to-end digital solutions tailored to your goals. Our team builds reliable technologies and intuitive interfaces that bring real value to both users and businesses.

mission.title: mission
mission.content: To bridge the gap between physical infrastructure and digital intelligence — making data work for people, not the other way around.

vision.title: vision
vision.content: A world where every asset, process, and decision is connected, transparent, and efficient — without complexity.

process.title: process
process.intro: We keep it simple and human:
steps: Understand — we listen to real daily pains.
Build — we create lightweight, scalable tech.
Deliver — we deploy, train, and stay for support.

values.title: values
items: Clarity — no buzzwords, no hidden agendas
Impact — we measure success by what we solve, not what we sell
Simplicity — if it's not easy to use, it's not done
Partnership — your growth is our only KPI

CookiesPolicy.description: At Hebent  Tech, we use cookies to enhance your browsing experience, analyze site traffic, and personalize content. Cookies are small text files stored on your device that help us remember your preferences and understand how you interact with our website.
CookiesPolicy.what: What types of cookies do we use?

categories.title: Essential Cookies:
categories.description: Necessary for the website to function properly, enabling basic features like page navigation and access to secure areas.

categories.title: Performance Cookies:
categories.description: Collect information about how visitors use our site, helping us improve speed and usability.

categories.title: Functional Cookies:
categories.description: Remember your preferences and settings to provide a more personalized experience.

categories.title: Advertising Cookies:
categories.description: Used to deliver relevant ads based on your interests and to measure the effectiveness of marketing campaigns.

CookiesPolicy.p1: You can control or disable cookies through your browser settings. Please note that blocking certain cookies may affect the functionality and user experience of our website. For more information about cookies and how to manage them, visit www.aboutcookies.org.
CookiesPolicy.p2: For more information about cookies and how to manage them, visit:
CookiesPolicy.p3: By continuing to use our website, you consent to our use of cookies in accordance with this policy.

PrivacyPolicy.description1: At Hebent Tech, we are committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect the personal information you provide to us when you use our website <link>hebent.tech</link> and any of our services.
PrivacyPolicy.description2: We may collect the following types of information:

items1.title: Personal Information:
items1.description: When you contact us, apply for a job, or use our services, you may provide personal details such as your name, email address, phone number, or resume.

items1.title: Usage Data:
items1.description: We may collect data about how you interact with our website, including IP address, browser type, pages visited, time spent on pages, and referring websites.

items1.title: Cookies and Tracking Technologies:
items1.description: We use cookies and similar technologies to improve your experience, analyze usage patterns, and personalize content. You can control cookie preferences in your browser settings.

items2.description: Communicate with you (e.g., responses, updates, newsletters)
Analyze website performance and user behavior

PrivacyPolicy.span: We will never sell or rent your personal information to third parties.
